Sam K: Quick ping — AP-412 postmortem follow-ups are past due. Owners listed in the tracker: @Priya R, @Alex C, @Jordan L. Status?
Priya R: Sorry, blocked on infra review. PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/456 — awaiting infra signoff.
Alex C: Waiting on QA test cases from Lina, hoping to get them tomorrow morning.
Jordan L: I own the rollback playbook update, nearly finished. Will push a draft by EOD.
remind-bot: Reminder set for AP-412 actions: 48h before closure check.
Sam K: @Ops Manager tagging for visibility — several action SLAs exceeded. Need explicit ETAs or reassignments.
Ops Manager: Noted. Priya/Alex/Jordan: please update the postmortem action tracker with concrete ETAs by COB today or we escalate to on-call rotation owners.
Priya R: ack — I'll add an ETA (need infra review). Blocking item: infra-req-22 (ticket INFRA-22).
Alex C: I'll sync with QA lead at 10am and update tracker by 2pm PT.
Jordan L: Playbook PR is up: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/459 — needs one reviewer @Mike B.
Mike B: Reviewing now, should be able to merge today after small nits.
Sam K: If these aren't closed by tomorrow EOD I'll reassign to keep SLAs intact. Also flagging a recurring pattern — this is the third incident in the last quarter with delayed rollouts causing action drift. Please add a preventive remediation to the postmortem (pre-deploy checklist).
Priya R: Adding "pre-deploy checklist" as a new action item in the tracker and linking to the postmortem.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-04-05 17:00 PT.
Alex C: Updated tracker with QA ETA and linked test plan doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AP/QA+Test+Plan+AP-412
Priya R: Infra review completed, PR merged and deployed to staging.
Jordan L: Rollback playbook updated and attached to the postmortem doc.
Sam K: Thanks all — marking this as verified in the tracker. Please create a quick retro card for the recurring delay pattern and assign to the platform team for process work.
Ops Manager: Will add to Eng Ops sync agenda and follow up on assignment.
